exposure: Delivery assistance by a health worker
cohort: 14,724 women aged 15-49 years from the 2017 Indonesian Health and Demographics Survey.
finding: Factors significantly associated with PNC service utilization were: college and secondary level education, working status, high economic status, residence in the Java-Bali region, delivery assistance by a health worker, delivery by cesarean section, and complete antenatal care.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was significantly associated with increased PNC service utilization.
